SISAL: A game's name is a link ONLY on the promotion's own page (underlined slot name). Tapping a game name or tile anywhere else (promotion list, casino lobby, search results) does nothing useful or starts the REAL-MONEY game.

Preferred route to the slot: stay on the promotion's own page after activating it and tap the underlined slot name there. Do NOT leave that page after a single missed tap: describe the link more precisely and try once more. If you do have to reopen the promotion: once activated, it disappears from the main promotions list and moves to the 'Promozioni attivate' (activated promotions) section, reachable from the promotions page; open that section, enter the promotion and tap the underlined slot name. Never scroll the main list looking for an activated promotion.

Alternative route: use the casino search bar ('Quale slot stai cercando?') to find the slot. In DEMO mode NEVER tap the game's box or its title: tap the small round 'i' (info) icon at the bottom-right INSIDE the box; it opens the slot page where 'Prova' is available.
Close app-download and cookie banners first: they hide useful tools such as the search bar.

A notification from another app (for example Telegram) at the top of the screen is not part of the site: never tap it and never wait for it, it disappears by itself; keep operating on the page. If the element you need is covered by it, wait once.
